div.div: آذِىٌّ , (S, M, K, &c.,) with medd and teshdeed, (TA, [in the CK, erroneously, اَذِىّ,]) Waves (S, M, K) of the sea: (S:) or vehement waves: (TA:) or the أَطْبَاق [app. meaning rollers, because they fall over like folds,] which the wind raises from the surface of the water, less than (دُونَ [but this sometimes signifies above]) what are termed مَوْج: (ISh, TA:) pl. أَوَاذِىُّ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
